entries.text: Welcome to the Alfornada Gym! Would you like\nme to explain the rules of the Gym Test again?
entries.label: gym_esper_020_receptionist_01

entries.text: The Gym Test here is a special kind of [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]exercise[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]!
entries.label: gym_esper_020_receptionist_02

entries.text: I’m talking about the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Emotional Spectrum[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Practice[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] created by Tulip herself, of course.\r\nComplete it, and you pass the test!
entries.label: gym_esper_020_receptionist_03

entries.text:
Head out of the Gym and turn left to find the
practice area.\c
The woman wearing a black tracksuit will explain
the rules to you there.
entries.label: gym_esper_020_receptionist_04

entries.text: Osu! Welcome, new kid! This is where we do\nEmotional Spectrum Practice.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: gym_esper_020_trainer_01

entries.text: Why is your battle studies teacher here at a\nPokémon Gym working as an instructor, you ask?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: gym_esper_020_trainer_02

entries.text: Well, I’ve been friends with the Gym Leader\nhere, Tulip, since we were kids.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: gym_esper_020_trainer_03

entries.text: We decided to have a Pokémon battle with a\nspecial rule—the loser has to do what the winner\r\nsays. So we battled, and, well...[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: gym_esper_020_trainer_25

entries.text: Look, never mind what happened! Point is, this is\na chance to both get a workout in and help my\r\nfriend when I don’t have classes![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: gym_esper_020_trainer_26

entries.text:
The rules of Emotional Spectrum Practice—or ESP
for short—are simple!\c
I’ll show you a certain movement, and all you
have to do is copy it![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: gym_esper_020_trainer_04

entries.text: Ready to get this Gym Test started? I hope your\nbody and mind are ready for the challenge![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: gym_esper_020_trainer_05

entries.text: Great! Let’s get to exercising! Show me an\neruption of emotions![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: gym_esper_020_trainer_06

entries.text: OK! Preparation is important, after all. Come\ntalk to me again when you’re good and ready![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: gym_esper_020_trainer_07

entries.text: Nice! You’re moving really well! Both you and\nyour Pokémon are looking great, new kid![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: gym_esper_020_trainer_08

entries.text: That was awesome! I can’t stop grinning after\nwitnessing such perfect power of expression![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: gym_esper_020_trainer_27

entries.text: That’s enough of a warm-up! Now let’s really put\nthose muscles to work with a Pokémon battle![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: gym_esper_020_trainer_09

entries.text: You gotta keep moving! This is no ordinary\nbattle—this is a workout!
entries.label: gym_esper_020_battle_a_01

entries.text: Great! I can hear your Pokémon AND your\nmuscles screaming with delight![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: gym_esper_020_trainer_10

entries.text: I see you’re getting tired, but you’ve gotta hang\nin there! Time to start the second half![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: gym_esper_020_trainer_11

entries.text: Covered in sweat and overflowing with emotion!\nThat was an impressive round![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: gym_esper_020_trainer_12

entries.text: That was perfect! I almost lost track of who was\nteaching who![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: gym_esper_020_trainer_28

entries.text: Don’t give up yet! It’s time for another battle!\nHold out against all that lactic acid![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: gym_esper_020_trainer_24

entries.text: My goal is to grow strong and build muscle.\nAny tips?
entries.label: gym_esper_020_battle_b_01

entries.text: Good job! You made it all the way through the\nESP exercise![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: gym_esper_020_trainer_13

entries.text: You passed this test—no doubt about it!\nCongratulations![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: gym_esper_020_trainer_14

entries.text:
But you’re not done yet! Sprint over to the lobby
staffer on the double!\c
You have to report your passing grade to
formally finish the Gym Test![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: gym_esper_020_trainer_15

entries.text: Awww, that was close! But it looks like you may\nneed to train a bit harder before you can take\r\non the Psychic-type Gym for real![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: gym_esper_020_trainer_16

entries.text: If you don’t plan on giving up, come back again\nsometime and show me what you’re made of![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: gym_esper_020_trainer_17

entries.text: Welcome back to the Emotional Spectrum\nPractice area, new kid![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: gym_esper_020_trainer_18
